/* GPU Image Enhancer Public Module API 1.2 — Paper Restoration v0.4.6 normal-use build (release number provisional)
 * Pre-filter with edge-based paper-color suggestions.
 * All RGB math is performed in sRGB numerical space; straight alpha is retained.
 * Only host-provided CPU analysis samples; no raw WebGL, GPU readback, or DOM.
 */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const L = (key, fallback) => ({key, fallback});
  const fragment = `#version 300 es
precision highp float;
precision highp int;
precision highp sampler2D;
in vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D image;
uniform vec3 paperRgb;
uniform float strength;
uniform float tolerance;
uniform float inkProtection;
uniform float colorProtection;
uniform float spatialAmount;
uniform int paperFieldMode;
uniform vec3 edgePaper[4];
uniform vec3 localPaper[9];
layout(location=0) out vec4 outColor;

float smooth01(float lo, float hi, float x) {
  float t = clamp((x - lo) / max(hi - lo, 0.00001), 0.0, 1.0);
  return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t);
}
void main() {
  vec4 src = texture(image, v_uv);
  vec3 c = clamp(src.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
  // Bilinear interpolation over a 3x3 low-frequency paper-color field.
  // Grid values are derived from original-image CPU samples, not printed artwork.
  vec2 g = clamp(v_uv, vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0)) * 2.0;
  ivec2 cell = min(ivec2(floor(g)), ivec2(1));
  vec2 f = g - vec2(cell);
  f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
  int i = cell.y * 3 + cell.x;
  vec3 upper = mix(localPaper[i], localPaper[i+1], f.x);
  vec3 lower = mix(localPaper[i+3], localPaper[i+4], f.x);
  vec3 field = mix(upper, lower, f.y);
  // Standard edge field: four independently estimated 7% border strips.
  // Blend towards the closest border, smoothly fading by 20% image depth.
  vec2 uv = clamp(v_uv, vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
  vec4 edgeWeight = vec4(
    1.0 - smooth01(0.0, 0.20, uv.y),
    1.0 - smooth01(0.0, 0.20, 1.0 - uv.y),
    1.0 - smooth01(0.0, 0.20, uv.x),
    1.0 - smooth01(0.0, 0.20, 1.0 - uv.x));
  float weightSum = edgeWeight.x + edgeWeight.y + edgeWeight.z + edgeWeight.w;
  vec3 edgeField = weightSum > 0.00001 ?
    (edgePaper[0] * edgeWeight.x + edgePaper[1] * edgeWeight.y +
     edgePaper[2] * edgeWeight.z + edgePaper[3] * edgeWeight.w) / weightSum : field;
  float edgeMix = paperFieldMode == 1 ? clamp(weightSum, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
  vec3 selectedField = mix(field, edgeField, edgeMix);
  vec3 paper = clamp(mix(paperRgb, selectedField, spatialAmount), vec3(0.05), vec3(1.0));
  float y = dot(c, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
  // Relative RGB offsets distinguish the paper tint from many printed inks.
  vec2 chroma = vec2(c.r - c.g, c.b - c.g);
  vec2 key = vec2(paper.r - paper.g, paper.b - paper.g);
  float chromaDistance = length(chroma - key);
  float colorMatch = 1.0 - smooth01(tolerance * 0.35, tolerance, chromaDistance);
  // Only lift relatively bright paper; dark text and linework stay unchanged.
  float lightMask = smooth01(inkProtection, min(0.98, inkProtection + 0.35), y);
  float peak = max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b));
  float valley = min(c.r, min(c.g, c.b));
  float saturation = (peak - valley) / max(peak, 0.00001);
  // Keep saturated print colors. Paper with moderate tint is still eligible.
  float vividMask = 1.0 - colorProtection * smooth01(0.30, 0.75, saturation);
  float mask = clamp(strength * colorMatch * lightMask * vividMask, 0.0, 1.0);
  // Channel-specific gain makes the selected paper color neutral white.
  // Clamp to avoid unbounded amplification in 16F processing.
  vec3 corrected = min(c / paper, vec3(1.0));
  vec3 rgb = mix(src.rgb, corrected, mask);
  outColor = vec4(rgb, src.a);
}`;
  const descriptor = {
    moduleApiVersion: 1,
    executionApiVersion: 1,
    kind: 'filter',
    id: 'sosboy-san.paper-restoration',
    name: '紙地復元 / Paper Restoration',
    version: '0.4.6',
    author: 'sosboy-san',
    implementationRevision: 'paper-key-selective-gain-v1-spatial-grid-v1-edge-strips-v1-normal-ui-v1',
    supportedStages: ['pre'],
    requiresFeatures: ['color-suggestions', 'visible-when', 'analysis-display'],
    description: '黄ばんだ紙や紙色ムラを、印刷色や輪郭線をなるべく残しながら補正する前処理フィルター。',
    readme: '古い漫画やスキャン画像の黄ばんだ紙を、印刷色や輪郭線をなるべく残しながら白く補正します。紙色は自動推定でき、手動指定も可能です。外周4辺を優先し、中央へ滑らかに3×3の紙色推定へ切り替えることで、場所による色ムラにも対応します。\n\n「紙色の復元度」は補正の強さです。100%で補正を最大限適用し、50%では元画像の色味を一部残し、0%では元画像のままです。100%でも全画素を白くするわけではありません。\n「紙色ムラへの追従度」は場所ごとの推定紙色の反映量です。100%で全面的に採用し、0%では全体の推定紙色だけを使います。手動時は指定した紙色を基準にします。復元度とは役割が異なります。\n「鮮やかな色の保護」を上げると印刷色を守りやすくなりますが、強い黄ばみも残る場合があります。0%でも紙色判定と暗部保護は働きます。\n「紙色の判定範囲」を広げると補正対象が増えますが、印刷色にも影響する場合があります。「暗部保護」は文字や輪郭線などを守る明度しきい値です。\n\n初期値：紙色は自動、復元度100%、判定範囲0.20、暗部保護0.30、鮮やかな色の保護50%、ムラへの追従度100%。手動紙色の初期値は#DCC68Fです。\n紙色推定は万能ではなく、紙色に近い印刷色も補正される場合があります。作品によっては色の保護を上げ、黄ばみの完全除去より自然な見た目を優先してください。元画像ファイルは変更しません。\n\n紙地復元 / Paper Restoration\n作者：sosboy-san\nバージョン：0.4.6\nパッケージID：sosboy-san.paper-restoration\nGPU Image Enhancer Public Module API 1.2 / Pre-filter\nCPUサンプルで紙色を推定し、WebGL2 / GLSL ES 3.00によりGPUで描画します。補正はsRGB数値空間で行います。',
    parameters: [
      {key:'paperMode', type:'enum', label:L('paper.mode','紙色の決定方法'), default:'auto', options:[
        {value:'auto',label:L('paper.mode.auto','自動')},
        {value:'manual',label:L('paper.mode.manual','手動')}
      ]},
      {key:'paperColor', type:'color', label:L('paper.color','手動の紙色'), default:'#DCC68F', visibleWhen:{key:'paperMode',equals:'manual'}, suggestions:{analysisPath:'data.paperCandidates', maxItems:4}},
      {key:'strength', type:'integer', label:L('paper.restorationDegree','紙色の復元度（%）'), min:0, max:100, step:5, default:100},
      {key:'tolerance', type:'number', label:L('paper.detectionRange','紙色の判定範囲'), min:0.02, max:0.5, step:0.01, default:0.20},
      {key:'inkProtection', type:'number', label:L('paper.darkProtection','暗部保護'), min:0.05, max:0.65, step:0.05, default:0.30},
      {key:'colorProtection', type:'integer', label:L('paper.colorProtection','鮮やかな色の保護（%）'), min:0, max:100, step:5, default:50},
      {key:'spatialAmount', type:'integer', label:L('paper.unevennessFollowing','紙色ムラへの追従度（%）'), min:0, max:100, step:5, default:100},

    ],
    analysisDisplay: [{
      type:'color',
      label:L('paper.detected','自動で採用した紙色'),
      analysisPath:'data.adoptedPaperColor',
      visibleWhen:{key:'paperMode',equals:'auto'}
    }],
    analysis: {
      revision: 'paper-edge-candidates-v2-auto-adopt-v1-spatial-grid-v1-edge-strips-v1-normal-v1',
      backend: 'cpu',
      target: 'original',
      parameterKeys: [],
      sample: {regions: [
        {rect:[0,0,1,0.07],method:'nearest',width:192,height:12},
        {rect:[0,0.93,1,0.07],method:'nearest',width:192,height:12},
        {rect:[0,0.07,0.07,0.86],method:'nearest',width:12,height:192},
        {rect:[0.93,0.07,0.07,0.86],method:'nearest',width:12,height:192},
        {rect:[0.000000,0.000000,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.333333,0.000000,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.666667,0.000000,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.000000,0.333333,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.333333,0.333333,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.666667,0.333333,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.000000,0.666667,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.333333,0.666667,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64},
        {rect:[0.666667,0.666667,0.333333,0.333333],method:'nearest',width:64,height:64}
      ]},
      resultSchema: {type:'object',properties:{
        paperCandidates:{type:'array',maxItems:4,items:{type:'string',maxLength:7}},
        adoptedPaperColor:{type:'string',maxLength:7},
        localPaper:{type:'array',maxItems:9,items:{type:'string',maxLength:7}},
        edgePaper:{type:'array',maxItems:4,items:{type:'string',maxLength:7}},

      }}
    },
    create(host) {
      let program = null;
      return {
        prepare() {
          program = host.createProgram({
            fragment,
            samplers:['image'],
            uniforms:{
              paperRgb:{type:'vec3'},
              strength:{type:'float'},
              tolerance:{type:'float'},
              inkProtection:{type:'float'},
              colorProtection:{type:'float'},
              spatialAmount:{type:'float'},
              paperFieldMode:{type:'int'},
              edgePaper:{type:'vec3',length:4},
              localPaper:{type:'vec3',length:9}
            }
          });
          return {supported:true};
        },
        analyze({sample, signal}) {
          // Small, deterministic edge sample. No mutable global state or DOM access.
          const samples = [];
          for (const region of sample.regions.slice(0,4)) {
            const pix = region.pixels;
            for (let i = 0; i < pix.length; i += 4) {
              if ((i & 8191) === 0 && signal?.aborted) throw new Error('Analysis cancelled');
              if (pix[i+3] < 240) continue;
              const r=pix[i], g=pix[i+1], b=pix[i+2];
              const hi=Math.max(r,g,b), lo=Math.min(r,g,b);
              const lum=(0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b)/255;
              const chroma=(hi-lo)/255;
              // Reject dark linework and saturated colored illustrations.
              if (lum < 0.56 || chroma > 0.42) continue;
              // Paper is generally light and fairly low-chroma; do not force warm-only.
              samples.push({r,g,b,lum,chroma});
            }
          }
          if (samples.length < 24) {
            // Do not substitute the saved manual color for a missing auto result.
            // Analysis failure follows the host's existing original-image fallback.
            throw new Error('Insufficient paper-like pixels for automatic estimation');
          }
          // Use observed edge pixels only. Cluster into coarse sRGB bins to
          // suppress isolated printing artifacts, then choose perceptually
          // separated medoids (actual sampled colors), never synthetic colors.
          const bins = new Map();
          for (const x of samples) {
            const key = `${x.r>>4},${x.g>>4},${x.b>>4}`;
            let bin = bins.get(key);
            if (!bin) {bin={n:0,r:0,g:0,b:0,points:[]};bins.set(key,bin);}
            bin.n++; bin.r+=x.r;bin.g+=x.g;bin.b+=x.b;
            // Keep a small deterministic set of observed representatives.
            if (bin.points.length < 16) bin.points.push(x);
          }
          const linear = v => {v/=255;return v<=0.04045?v/12.92:((v+0.055)/1.055)**2.4;};
          const lab = (r,g,b) => {
            r=linear(r);g=linear(g);b=linear(b);
            const l=Math.cbrt(0.4122214708*r+0.5363325363*g+0.0514459929*b);
            const m=Math.cbrt(0.2119034982*r+0.6806995451*g+0.1073969566*b);
            const t=Math.cbrt(0.0883024619*r+0.2817188376*g+0.6299787005*b);
            return [0.2104542553*l+0.793617785*m-0.0040720468*t,
              1.9779984951*l-2.428592205*m+0.4505937099*t,
              0.0259040371*l+0.7827717662*m-0.808675766*t];
          };
          const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]);
          const minBinCount=Math.max(5,Math.ceil(samples.length*0.002));
          const clusters=[...bins.values()].filter(x=>x.n>=minBinCount)
            .map(x=>{
              const center=[x.r/x.n,x.g/x.n,x.b/x.n];
              const centerLab=lab(...center);
              const point=x.points.reduce((best,p)=>{
                const d=distance(lab(p.r,p.g,p.b),centerLab);
                return !best||d<best.d?{p,d}:best;
              },null).p;
              return {n:x.n,hex:'#'+[point.r,point.g,point.b]
                .map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase(),
                lab:lab(point.r,point.g,point.b),lum:point.lum};
            });
          // The most frequent bin is the representative paper color.
          clusters.sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n || b.lum-a.lum || a.hex.localeCompare(b.hex));
          const chosen=[];
          if(clusters.length) chosen.push(clusters[0]);
          // A meaningful visual difference matters more than filling four slots.
          // Farthest-first selection favors both dark yellowing and pale paper,
          // while requiring a minimum prevalence for every offered swatch.
          const minDelta=0.045;
          while(chosen.length<4){
            let best=null, bestScore=-1;
            for(const c of clusters){
              if(chosen.includes(c))continue;
              const separation=Math.min(...chosen.map(x=>distance(c.lab,x.lab)));
              if(separation<minDelta)continue;
              const score=separation*(0.8+0.2*Math.min(1,c.n/(minBinCount*4)));
              if(score>bestScore){best=c;bestScore=score;}
            }
            if(!best)break;
            chosen.push(best);
          }
          const candidates=chosen.map(x=>x.hex);
          if (!candidates.length) {
            // Coarse bins can be too sparse on highly varied scans. Use an
            // observed eligible pixel nearest the mean, not an invented color.
            const mean=samples.reduce((a,x)=>[a[0]+x.r,a[1]+x.g,a[2]+x.b],[0,0,0]).map(v=>v/samples.length);
            const observed=samples.reduce((best,x)=>{
              const d=(x.r-mean[0])**2+(x.g-mean[1])**2+(x.b-mean[2])**2;
              return !best||d<best.d?{x,d}:best;
            },null).x;
            candidates.push('#'+[observed.r,observed.g,observed.b].map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase());
          }
          // Each of the 9 spatial cells estimates its own paper color. A cell
          // without convincing paper pixels inherits the global estimate.
          // The spatial field is restricted to small differences from global
          // to prevent artwork or black fills from driving local correction.
          const base = candidates[0].match(/[0-9A-F]{2}/g).map(x=>parseInt(x,16));
          const toHex = rgb => '#'+rgb.map(v=>Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(255,v))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase();
          const localPaper = sample.regions.slice(4,13).map(region=>{
            const pix=region.pixels;
            const eligible=[];
            for(let i=0;i<pix.length;i+=4){
              if ((i&8191)===0 && signal?.aborted) throw new Error('Analysis cancelled');
              if(pix[i+3]<240)continue;
              const r=pix[i],g=pix[i+1],b=pix[i+2];
              const hi=Math.max(r,g,b),lo=Math.min(r,g,b);
              const lum=(.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b)/255;
              if(lum<.56)continue;
              if((hi-lo)/255>.42)continue;
              const cd=Math.hypot((r-g)-(base[0]-base[1]),(b-g)-(base[2]-base[1]));
              if(cd>40)continue;
              eligible.push([r,g,b]);
            }
            const minimum=Math.max(48,Math.floor(pix.length/4*.08));
            if(eligible.length<minimum)return candidates[0];
            const med=[0,1,2].map(k=>{
              const values=eligible.map(c=>c[k]).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
              return values[Math.floor(values.length/2)];
            });
            const bounded=med.map((v,k)=>Math.max(base[k]-36,Math.min(base[k]+36,v)));
            return toHex(bounded);
          });
          // Each border is estimated independently from the same original 7% samples.
          // Use the global paper chroma to avoid treating bright artwork as paper.
          const edgePaper=sample.regions.slice(0,4).map(region=>{
            const pix=region.pixels;
            const eligible=[];
            for(let i=0;i<pix.length;i+=4){
              if ((i&8191)===0 && signal?.aborted) throw new Error('Analysis cancelled');
              if(pix[i+3]<240)continue;
              const r=pix[i],g=pix[i+1],b=pix[i+2];
              const hi=Math.max(r,g,b),lo=Math.min(r,g,b);
              const lum=(.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b)/255;
              if(lum<.56 || (hi-lo)/255>.42)continue;
              const cd=Math.hypot((r-g)-(base[0]-base[1]),(b-g)-(base[2]-base[1]));
              if(cd>40)continue;
              eligible.push([r,g,b]);
            }
            const minimum=Math.max(24,Math.floor(pix.length/4*.08));
            const fallback=eligible.length<minimum;
            const med=fallback?base:[0,1,2].map(k=>{
              const values=eligible.map(c=>c[k]).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
              return values[Math.floor(values.length/2)];
            });
            const bounded=med.map((v,k)=>Math.max(base[k]-36,Math.min(base[k]+36,v)));
            const estimatedColor=toHex(bounded);
            return estimatedColor;
          });
          return {data:{paperCandidates:candidates,adoptedPaperColor:candidates[0],localPaper,edgePaper}};
        },
        execute({input, output, parameters:p, analysis}) {
          if (p.strength <= 0) return {kind:'passthrough'};
          const selectedColor = p.paperMode === 'auto'
            ? analysis?.data?.adoptedPaperColor
            : p.paperColor;
          if (typeof selectedColor !== 'string' || !/^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(selectedColor)) {
            throw new Error('Automatic paper color is unavailable');
          }
          const baseRgb=host.colorToRgb(analysis?.data?.adoptedPaperColor || selectedColor);
          const grid=(analysis?.data?.localPaper?.length===9 ? analysis.data.localPaper : Array(9).fill(selectedColor))
            .flatMap(hex=>{
              const rgb=host.colorToRgb(hex);
              // In manual mode preserve the local variation but anchor it to
              // the user-selected base color, without changing the saved value.
              const manual=host.colorToRgb(selectedColor);
              return p.paperMode==='auto'?rgb:rgb.map((v,i)=>Math.max(.05,Math.min(1,manual[i]+v-baseRgb[i])));
            });
          const edgeGrid=(analysis?.data?.edgePaper?.length===4 ? analysis.data.edgePaper : Array(4).fill(selectedColor))
            .flatMap(hex=>{
              const rgb=host.colorToRgb(hex);
              const manual=host.colorToRgb(selectedColor);
              return p.paperMode==='auto'?rgb:rgb.map((v,i)=>Math.max(.05,Math.min(1,manual[i]+v-baseRgb[i])));
            });
          host.drawPass({
            program,
            inputs:{image:input},
            output,
            uniforms:{
              paperRgb:host.colorToRgb(selectedColor),
              strength:p.strength / 100,
              tolerance:p.tolerance,
              inkProtection:p.inkProtection,
              colorProtection:p.colorProtection / 100,
              spatialAmount:p.spatialAmount / 100,
              paperFieldMode:1,
              edgePaper:edgeGrid,
              localPaper:grid
            }
          });
          return {kind:'written'};
        },
        dispose() {
          if (program !== null) {
            host.releaseProgram(program);
            program = null;
          }
        }
      };
    }
  };
  (globalThis.__KKGR_MODULES__ ??= []).push(descriptor);
})();
